hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a symbolic template T(theta)=V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta). Instantiate by substituting theta->p and theta->q to recover the two summands; the full expression is the sum over theta in {p,q}.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are unary functions accepting the same symbol/argument type.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands have identical operator-product form V(x)*G0(x)*V(x) and differ only by the free symbol p versus q; this is a direct structural parameterization, not a physical interpretation.
